children.value: Fact From Story: The report showed Alameda’s largest asset was $3.66 billion of “unlocked FTT” and $2.16 billion of “FTT collateral.”
> > Fact From Story: FTT was the token behind FTX.
> > > Fact From Story: The balance sheet showed that the $5.82 billion in FTT tokens that Alameda owned was 193% higher than the total FTT market cap, which was about $3 billion at the time.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A company's assets should not be higher than the total market cap.
Fact From Story: CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet.
> > Fact From Story: Concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity grew after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet
> > > Fact From Story: The report showed Alameda’s largest asset was $3.66 billion of “unlocked FTT” and $2.16 billion of “FTT collateral.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: An asset being a token of the company itself can be a cause for concern.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Leaked information can cause concern.
Commonsense Knowledge: A balance sheet shows a company's assets and liabilities.
